5th Level

5th Level

  • When you would succeed at a Crafting check, you critically succeed instead.
  • You may Craft without a workshop, using only what you carry.
  • You may substitute any raw materials for any others of equal or greater value.
  • Crafting an item takes 1 day and costs 75% of the item's Price.
    • This cost is fixed and cannot be reduced by spending additional time.

Granted automatically by Peerless Crafter at 5th level.
